title: Learning from Contrasts: Synthesizing Reasoning Paths from Diverse Search Trajectories
authors_zh: Peiyang Liu、Zhirui Chen、Xi Wang、Di Liang、Youru Li、Zhi Cai、Wei Ye
paper_type_zh: 对比搜索轨迹合成与开放数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究 MCTS 数据构造、失败轨迹蒸馏、SFT 扩展和发布审计的读者
one_line: CRPS contrasts successful MCTS paths with high-confidence failures or inefficient successes, uses GPT-5-mini to synthesize verified reasoning traces, and releases 27,256 final math problem/solution pairs.
CRPS 对比 MCTS 成功路径与高访问失败或低效正确路径，由 GPT-5-mini 合成终局答案可验证的轨迹；公开集实际为 27,256 条。
why: It operationalizes failure-aware search-trace distillation and shows favorable SFT scaling, while its missing intermediate artifacts and count, cost, configuration, and license inconsistencies make it a useful release-audit case.
inclusion_reason: CRPS is a direct data-construction recipe that turns both successful and failed search trajectories into critique-conditioned SFT traces, with an official code repository and final dataset release that also expose important open-release audit gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Monte Carlo Tree Search can produce a tree of plausible, successful, failed, and inefficient reasoning paths, yet common data pipelines keep only a highest-reward path. Contrastive Reasoning Path Synthesis (CRPS) asks how to convert differences inside that search distribution into compact supervised data instead of treating MCTS only as a filter. The official ACL 2026 paper appeared in the conference proceedings on July 2-7, 2026; its code link is printed on the paper's first page.

Three objects must remain distinct. The construction substrate is an MCTS tree with node states, candidate reasoning actions, visits, node values, complete trajectories, and binary terminal outcomes. The contrastive intermediate pairs one positive anchor with either a high-visit incorrect hard negative or a longer correct soft negative, then adds analyst-generated global and local critiques. The released training object is only a newly synthesized problem/solution pair retained after final-answer verification. It is static SFT data, not a released search tree, preference pair, process-reward record, or online RL episode.

This places CRPS in data_construction_open_release_recipes: the official paper, code repository, and CRPS-30K dataset expose a concrete search-to-SFT recipe and a final data artifact. The decision boundary is narrower than all MCTS or contrastive-learning work: the card covers how search trajectories become released reasoning demonstrations, not test-time search itself or contrastive representation learning.

The release boundary remains incomplete. The public dataset card reports 27,256 examples over 9,939 unique problems despite the 30K name, and rows omit MCTS nodes, selected contrasts, critiques, verifier logs, rejects, and record-level source lineage. The bilingual Card is L4_chinese_review_ready, while the release remains partial: final SFT rows and code are available, but the intermediate construction trail is not auditable end to end.

Monte Carlo Tree Search 能产生包含合理、成功、失败和低效推理路径的搜索树，但常见数据流程只保留最高奖励路径。Contrastive Reasoning Path Synthesis（CRPS）研究如何把搜索分布内部的差异转成紧凑监督数据，而不是只把 MCTS 当作过滤器。ACL 2026 官方论文收录于 2026 年七月 2-7 日举行的会议论文集，论文首页给出了代码链接。

需要明确区分三种对象。构造底层对象是 MCTS 树，包含节点状态、候选推理动作、访问次数、节点值、完整轨迹和二元终局结果。对比中间对象把一条正锚点轨迹与高访问错误硬负例或较长正确软负例配对，再附加分析模型生成的全局与局部批评。最终发布的训练对象只是经过最终答案验证后保留的新合成 problem/solution 对。它是静态 SFT 数据，不是公开搜索树、偏好对、过程奖励记录或在线 RL episode。

因此，CRPS 属于 data_construction_open_release_recipes：官方论文、代码仓库与 CRPS-30K 数据集共同给出从搜索到 SFT 的具体配方和最终数据产物。这里的边界不是泛指所有 MCTS 或对比学习工作；本 Card 关注搜索轨迹如何变成公开推理示范，而不是测试时搜索或对比表征学习。

发布边界仍不完整。公开数据卡虽然命名为 30K，却报告 27,256 条样本和 9,939 个唯一问题；逐行数据不含 MCTS 节点、选中对比、批评、验证日志、拒绝项或记录级来源谱系。双语 Card 已达到 L4_chinese_review_ready，但发布状态仍为 partial：最终 SFT 样本与代码可用，中间构造链却不能端到端审计。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct explores each seed problem with UCT-based MCTS. Complete paths receive a binary terminal reward from answer correctness. Among correct paths, CRPS chooses the shortest as the positive anchor and breaks length ties with the highest maximum node Q-value. Search statistics are then used to construct two contrast types rather than choosing arbitrary negatives.

A hard negative is an incorrect trajectory sampled in proportion to accumulated visit count, so the contrast emphasizes failures that consumed substantial search attention. A soft negative is a correct trajectory longer than the positive anchor, intended to contrast strategic efficiency rather than correctness. The paper reports K=10 contrastive pairs and 10 MCTS rollouts per problem, but it does not state the experiment-level hard/soft mixture or fully reconcile pair availability, reuse, and stage yields. The checked implementation's sampler defaults to a 70%/30% hard/soft target, samples available negatives without replacement, and fills shortages from the other pool; that is code evidence, not an immutable release manifest.

GPT-5-mini receives the problem, positive path, and negative path. It first emits a structured global strategic comparison and a local critique around the first semantic divergence point, after heuristic segmentation into semantic reasoning acts. A second prompt asks the same analyst to synthesize a fresh step-structured solution that follows the success pattern, avoids the identified failure mode, and explains the relevant strategic choice without referring to an external critique.

The feedback contract has several layers but only one deterministic acceptance gate. MCTS terminal reward uses strict ground-truth answer matching; the analyst supplies unverified natural-language global and step-local critiques; post-hoc filtering extracts the synthesized final answer and accepts exact or SymPy-equivalent answers. This check observes terminal-answer equivalence. It cannot establish that every intermediate step is valid, that the identified divergence is causal, or that the synthesized reasoning faithfully implements the critique.

The closest construction contrast is selection-only MCTS or rejection sampling, which retains an existing correct path. CRPS instead turns a selected positive/negative pair into guidance for a newly generated positive demonstration. It differs from local refinement methods such as SIGMA because the analyst regenerates the path rather than patching one failed trajectory.

Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 使用基于 UCT 的 MCTS 探索每个种子问题，完整路径依据答案正确性获得二元终局奖励。在正确路径中，CRPS 选择最短路径作为正锚点；长度相同时，选择最大节点 Q 值最高的路径。随后，系统利用搜索统计构造两类对比，而不是任意挑选负例。

硬负例是按累计访问次数成比例采样的错误轨迹，使对比聚焦于占用了较多搜索注意力的失败。软负例是比正锚点更长的正确轨迹，用于对比策略效率而非答案正确性。论文报告每题 K=10 个对比对和 10 次 MCTS rollout，但没有说明实验级硬/软比例，也没有完整解释可用对数量、复用方式和各阶段产出率。核验实现中的采样器默认目标比例为硬负例 70%、软负例 30%，对可用负例采用无放回采样，并用另一池补足缺口；这是代码证据，不是不可变发布清单。

GPT-5-mini 接收问题、正轨迹和负轨迹。它先把轨迹启发式切分为语义推理动作，输出结构化的全局策略比较，并围绕第一个语义分歧点给出局部批评。第二阶段提示要求同一分析模型重新合成一条步骤化解答：遵循成功模式、绕开识别出的失败模式，并自然解释关键策略选择，而不提及外部批评。

反馈契约包含多个层次，但只有一个确定性的接收门槛。MCTS 终局奖励使用严格标准答案匹配；分析模型提供未经独立验证的自然语言全局与步骤级局部批评；后处理过滤器抽取合成结果的最终答案，只接受精确匹配或 SymPy 等价的答案。最后这一检查观察的是终局答案等价，不能证明每个中间步骤有效、分歧点具有因果意义，或合成推理忠实执行了批评。

最接近的构造对照是只做选择的 MCTS 或 rejection sampling，它们保留已有正确路径。CRPS 则把选定的正负轨迹对转成指导信息，再生成新的正向示范。它也不同于 SIGMA 等局部修订方法，因为分析模型会重写整条路径，而不是修补一条失败轨迹。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Source problems. The primary math pipeline draws approximately 7.5K problems each from the GSM8K and MATH training splits, for roughly 15K stated seeds. Exact immutable source revisions, seed identifiers, attrition, deduplication, and the mapping to the 9,939 unique problems in the public CRPS-30K artifact are not released.
  1. MCTS exploration. Use Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct as explorer with UCT. The released configuration sets c_puct=1.4, maximum depth 16 semantic reasoning steps, up to 3 actions per node, 10 rollouts per problem, temperature 0.7, a 256-token expansion/action budget, and a 2,048-token simulation budget. A semantic step is segmented by structural boundaries, logic connectors, and explicit enumeration, with a 256-token cap and no split inside mathematical expressions.
  1. Trajectory stratification. Assign each complete path a binary terminal outcome. Select the shortest correct path as positive anchor, breaking ties by maximum node Q. Treat incorrect paths as hard-negative candidates and correct paths longer than the anchor as soft-negative candidates. Hard negatives are weighted by accumulated visit count; soft negatives have no paper-specified excess-length threshold.
  1. Contrastive pairing. The paper states 10 contrastive pairs per problem. The checked implementation defaults to a 70%/30% hard/soft target, samples without replacement within each available pool, and fills shortages from the other pool. The paper does not report aggregate hard/soft counts, zero-pair problems, pair-level random seeds, or how 10 rollouts yield 10 usable contrasts for every retained problem.
  1. Dual-granularity analysis. GPT-5-mini compares a positive/negative pair and returns JSON containing a divergence-step index, local descriptions of each path, a critique of their difference, a global strategic analysis, a success pattern, and a failure mode to avoid. Regex extraction and rule-based repair handle malformed JSON; outputs still unparsable are discarded. The paper reports a parsing-failure rate below 5%, but not exact counts by analyst call, retry policy, or rejected instance.
  1. Fresh synthesis. Condition GPT-5-mini on the problem and contrastive insights to generate a new step-by-step path rather than editing either original trajectory. The released configuration uses analyst temperature 0.7 with 1,024 tokens and synthesis temperature 0 with 2,048 tokens. The analyst is instructed to weave the contrast into the solution without meta-language and to end with a boxed final answer.
  1. Verification and pool construction. Extract the final answer and retain only exact or SymPy-equivalent matches to the reference. Uniformly sample verified paths into nominal 15K, 30K, and 60K sets. The checked code samples without replacement if the pool is large enough and with replacement otherwise, but the public release does not expose verified-pool size, replacement flags, duplicates, rejects, or per-row construction lineage.
  1. SFT. Train the target base model on the problem as prompt and synthesized reasoning path as completion with ordinary causal-LM loss. The paper reports DeepSeekMath-7B-Base, LLaMA3-8B, and Mistral-7B-v0.1; full-parameter AdamW with beta1 0.9 and beta2 0.95, peak learning rate 2e-5, 3% warmup, cosine decay, global batch 128, 3 epochs, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 offload, and 8 A800 80GB GPUs. Search, analyst, synthesis, verification, and SFT costs must be accounted separately.
  1. Appendix-domain substitutions. Code experiments use Qwen2.5-Coder-7B with unit tests on HumanEval; commonsense experiments use LLaMA3-8B with exact-answer matching on StrategyQA. GPT-5-mini remains the analyst. The paper does not release matching code or commonsense datasets, seed manifests, or full construction budgets.

1. 来源问题。 主数学流程从 GSM8K 训练集和 MATH 训练集各取约 7.5K 道题，论文称总计约 15K 个种子。官方发布没有提供不可变来源版本、种子标识、流失情况、去重规则，也没有说明它们如何映射到公开 CRPS-30K 中的 9,939 个唯一问题。
  1. MCTS 探索。 使用 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 作为 explorer 并采用 UCT。发布配置设定 c_puct=1.4、最大深度 16 个语义推理步骤、每节点最多 3 个动作、每题 10 次 rollout、温度 0.7、扩展/动作上限 256 tokens、模拟上限 2,048 tokens。语义步骤依据结构边界、逻辑连接词和显式编号切分，每步最多 256 tokens，数学表达式内部不切分。
  1. 轨迹分层。 为每条完整路径赋予二元终局结果。选择最短正确路径作为正锚点，长度并列时取最大节点 Q 值最高者。错误路径作为硬负例候选，比锚点更长的正确路径作为软负例候选。硬负例按累计访问次数加权；论文没有为软负例规定额外长度阈值。
  1. 对比配对。 论文称每题构造 10 个对比对。核验实现默认硬/软目标比例为 70%/30%，在各可用池内无放回采样，并用另一个池补足缺口。论文没有报告整体硬/软数量、无法配对的问题数、配对级随机种子，也没有解释每题 10 次 rollout 如何始终产生 10 个可用对比。
  1. 双粒度分析。 GPT-5-mini 比较正负轨迹对，并返回 JSON：分歧步骤索引、两条路径的局部逻辑描述、差异批评、全局策略分析、成功模式和应避免的失败模式。流程用正则抽取和规则修复处理畸形 JSON，仍无法解析的输出被丢弃。论文称解析失败率低于 5%，但没有给出各类分析调用的准确计数、重试策略或拒绝实例。
  1. 重新合成。 GPT-5-mini 根据问题和对比信息生成一条新的逐步解答，而不是编辑任一原始轨迹。发布配置中分析温度为 0.7、上限 1,024 tokens，合成温度为 0、上限 2,048 tokens。提示要求把对比信息自然写入解答，避免元语言，并以盒装最终答案结束。
  1. 验证与数据池构造。 抽取最终答案，只保留与参考答案精确匹配或 SymPy 等价的路径，再从验证通过池中均匀采样名义 15K、30K 和 60K 数据集。核验代码在池足够大时无放回采样，否则有放回采样；公开发布没有给出验证池大小、是否发生放回、重复项、拒绝项或逐行构造谱系。
  1. SFT。 以问题为 prompt、合成推理路径为 completion，使用普通因果语言模型损失训练目标基础模型。论文报告的目标模型包括 DeepSeekMath-7B-Base、LLaMA3-8B 和 Mistral-7B-v0.1；使用全参数 AdamW，beta1 为 0.9、beta2 为 0.95，峰值学习率 2e-5，3% warmup，余弦衰减，全局 batch 128，训练 3 个 epoch，DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 offload 和 8 张 A800 80GB。搜索、分析、合成、验证与 SFT 成本必须分开核算。
  1. 附录领域替换。 代码实验在 HumanEval 上使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 与单元测试；常识实验在 StrategyQA 上使用 LLaMA3-8B 与精确答案匹配。GPT-5-mini 仍是分析模型。论文没有发布对应的代码或常识数据集、种子清单与完整构造预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest primary result is on DeepSeekMath-7B. At 30K nominal examples, CRPS reports an average accuracy of 50.4 across MATH, GSM8K, CollegeMath, DeepMind Mathematics, OlympiadBench, and TheoremQA, compared with 48.3 for 590K RFT and 49.4 for 590K DART-Math. At 60K, CRPS reaches 52.0. Parallel 30K results are 39.6 for LLaMA3-8B and 36.8 for Mistral-7B-v0.1, each above the reported same-scale SIGMA baseline. These are downstream results under the authors' pipeline, not validation of every critique or released row. (Paper Tables 1 and 5.)

Ablations separate synthesis from search and contrast selection. On DeepSeekMath-7B at 30K, black-box generation averages 45.1, Vanilla MCTS 47.7, synthesis without contrast 47.5, random contrast 48.3, and full CRPS 50.4. Removing global or local critiques lowers the reported average to 48.7 or 49.0, and increasing sampled-path diversity from K=3 to K=15 raises it from 48.1 to 50.6. These comparisons support the construction choices inside the reported setup, while the shared analyst and terminal verifier still confound attribution to data quality alone. (Table 3.)

The generalization analysis reports 40.3 average accuracy on four out-of-domain math benchmarks, versus 38.0 for SIGMA, and 64.5 strict consistency on 200 perturbed GSM8K pairs, versus 52.1 for Vanilla MCTS. Appendix experiments report 57.9 pass@1 on HumanEval with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and 75.8 exact match on StrategyQA with LLaMA3-8B. These are useful transfer signals, but the non-math seed counts, construction budgets, and public artifacts are not disclosed at the same depth as the math release. (Table 4, Table 6, Appendix C-E.)

The size-efficiency claim requires arithmetic care. The abstract pairs 60K CRPS with 590K baselines and calls this a 20x reduction, but 590K / 60K is approximately 9.8. A roughly 20x comparison is supported by nominal CRPS-30K versus 590K (approximately 19.7x) and by the reported target-model SFT cost of 10 versus 192 GPU-hours (19.2x). Table 7 covers recurring target-model training; the paper acknowledges additional MCTS and analyst inference overhead but does not publish a complete API-token, monetary, explorer-compute, verification, or retry cost ledger.

Release inspection is separate evidence from benchmark performance. The Hugging Face card reports 27,256 rows, 9,939 unique problems, two string fields, average 3.3 steps, and 100% boxed-answer coverage. The official code exposes pipeline modules and configurations, but at checked commit 0d8a807c7783e1e15c24668e17a8450dc028c6a9 it has one commit, no tagged release, no LICENSE file, and only lower-bound dependency constraints. Its paper-oriented config routes a model named gpt-5-mini through an anthropic backend with ANTHROPIC_* environment variables. These facts limit executable-replication confidence even though code and final data are public.

最主要的结果来自 DeepSeekMath-7B。名义 30K 样本下，CRPS 在 MATH、GSM8K、CollegeMath、DeepMind Mathematics、OlympiadBench 和 TheoremQA 上的平均准确率为 50.4；590K RFT 为 48.3，590K DART-Math 为 49.4。60K CRPS 达到 52.0。LLaMA3-8B 和 Mistral-7B-v0.1 在 30K 下分别为 39.6 和 36.8，也都高于报告的同规模 SIGMA。这些是作者流程下的下游结果，不能验证每条批评或发布样本。（论文表 1、表 5。）

消融实验把合成、搜索和对比选择拆开。在 DeepSeekMath-7B、30K 设置下，black-box generation 平均为 45.1，Vanilla MCTS 为 47.7，无对比合成为 47.5，随机对比为 48.3，完整 CRPS 为 50.4。移除全局或局部批评后分别降到 48.7 和 49.0；把采样路径多样性从 K=3 增加到 K=15，分数从 48.1 上升到 50.6。这些比较支持报告设置内的构造选择，但共享的分析模型与终局验证器仍会干扰“增益只来自数据质量”的归因。（表 3。）

泛化分析报告四个域外数学基准平均 40.3，SIGMA 为 38.0；在 200 对扰动 GSM8K 问题上的严格一致性为 64.5，Vanilla MCTS 为 52.1。附录实验使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 在 HumanEval 上报告 57.9 pass@1，使用 LLaMA3-8B 在 StrategyQA 上报告 75.8 精确匹配。这些是有用的迁移信号，但非数学实验的种子数量、构造预算和公开产物没有达到数学发布的披露深度。（表 4、表 6、附录 C-E。）

数据效率主张需要按算术谨慎表述。摘要把 60K CRPS 与 590K 基线比较并称减少 20 倍，但 590K / 60K 约为 9.8。接近 20 倍的比较由名义 CRPS-30K 对 590K（约 19.7 倍）以及报告的目标模型 SFT 训练 10 对 192 GPU-hours（19.2 倍）支持。表 7 只覆盖重复发生的目标模型训练；论文承认还存在 MCTS 与分析模型推理开销，却没有公布完整的 API token、金额、探索计算、验证或重试成本账本。

发布核验提供了与基准性能不同的证据。Hugging Face 数据卡报告 27,256 行、9,939 个唯一问题、两个字符串字段、平均 3.3 步和 100% 盒装答案覆盖。官方代码公开了流程模块和配置，但在核验 commit 0d8a807c7783e1e15c24668e17a8450dc028c6a9 上只有一个 commit，没有 tagged release 或 LICENSE 文件，依赖也仅声明版本下界。面向论文的配置还把名为 gpt-5-mini 的模型配置为 anthropic backend 和 ANTHROPIC_* 环境变量。这些事实降低了可执行复现置信度，尽管代码与最终数据确实公开。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
CRPS changes the supervision-extraction step after search. Instead of selecting one successful MCTS path or locally repairing a failed path, it uses search-distribution statistics to construct a positive/negative contrast, verbalizes both global strategy and local divergence, and conditions a stronger analyst to generate a fresh solution. Negative evidence influences the final positive demonstration without being exposed to the SFT learner as a negative label.

The hard/soft distinction is consequential. Hard negatives represent correctness failures that the search visited heavily; soft negatives represent inefficient but correct reasoning. The analyst can therefore ask two different questions: why an approach fails, and why a valid approach is unnecessarily long. The synthesis prompt converts those answers into explanatory choices inside an ordinary completion.

MCTS, UCT, rejection sampling, answer verifiers, self-refinement, teacher distillation, contrastive prompts, and SFT are not new individually. The paper's contribution is their decoupled composition: a specialized explorer maps a trajectory distribution, a stronger analyst compares selected paths at two granularities, and a final verifier filters newly synthesized traces. CRPS is not contrastive representation learning and does not train the target model with a contrastive loss.

The process-supervision claim needs a boundary. Step segmentation and local critiques create step-addressed intermediate artifacts during construction, but public CRPS-30K rows expose only final solutions and terminal answers. Critique fields are model-generated and not independently verified. CRPS is therefore evidence for process-informed construction, not proof of a released step-level ground-truth corpus.

Compared with selection-only search data, the method provides a more expressive recipe but a narrower release than the full construction object. Code and final problem/solution pairs are official; search trees, chosen positives and negatives, critiques, parser repairs, verification decisions, and rejected syntheses are not part of the confirmed dataset release. Reuse studies must preserve this distinction rather than treating public rows as replayable contrastive episodes.

CRPS 改变的是搜索之后的监督提取步骤。它不只选择一条成功 MCTS 路径，也不局部修补失败路径，而是利用搜索分布统计构造正负对比，把全局策略和局部分歧显式语言化，再让更强的分析模型生成一条全新解答。负面证据影响最终正向示范，但不会作为负标签直接呈现给 SFT 学习器。

硬/软负例区分具有实际意义。硬负例表示搜索大量访问但最终答错的失败，软负例表示正确但低效的推理。分析模型因此可以分别回答两个问题：某个方法为什么失败，以及某个有效方法为什么过长。合成提示再把这些答案转化为一条普通 completion 中带解释的策略选择。

MCTS、UCT、rejection sampling、答案验证器、自我修订、教师蒸馏、对比提示和 SFT 分别都不是新概念。论文的贡献在于解耦式组合：专门的 explorer 刻画轨迹分布，更强的分析模型在双粒度上比较选中路径，最终验证器过滤新合成轨迹。CRPS 不是对比表征学习，也不使用对比损失训练目标模型。

过程监督主张需要划清边界。步骤切分和局部批评在构造过程中产生了可定位到步骤的中间产物，但公开 CRPS-30K 行只暴露最终解答与终局答案。批评字段由模型生成，且没有独立验证。因此，CRPS 是过程信息参与构造的证据，不是公开步骤级真值语料已经成立的证明。

与只保留成功路径的搜索数据相比，该方法配方更丰富，但发布内容比完整构造对象窄。官方代码和最终问题/解答对已确认；搜索树、选中正负轨迹、批评、解析修复、验证决策和被拒绝合成结果均不在已确认数据发布中。复用研究必须保留这一差别，不能把公开行当作可重放的对比 episode。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Terminal verification is not process verification. Exact or SymPy-equivalent final answers can coexist with invalid, spurious, or unfaithful intermediate reasoning, and the verifier does not check critique consistency.
  • Critiques are model judgments. GPT-5-mini may misidentify the first divergence, confuse a local arithmetic error with a strategic failure, or impose unnecessary constraints. No independent critique-faithfulness verifier or human error annotation is reported.
  • Search-distribution assumptions can fail. High visit count is treated as evidence of a stubborn, informative failure, but a highly visited wrong branch can reflect UCT noise, value-estimation error, prompt bias, or duplicated states rather than a pedagogically useful misconception. This is a curator inference from the feedback contract.
  • Pair construction is incompletely specified. The paper states 10 rollouts and 10 contrastive pairs per problem without publishing per-problem path counts, hard/soft mixture, pair shortages, reuse, retries, or stage yields. The code's 70%/30% default is not a substitute for a paper-matching manifest.
  • Counts do not reconcile. The nominal CRPS-30K release contains 27,256 rows and 9,939 unique problems, versus roughly 15K seed problems and approximately two synthesized variants per seed described in the paper. Attrition, duplication, and selection are not mapped.
  • Lineage is lost at release. Final rows contain only problem and solution; they omit source IDs and revisions, tree nodes, visits and Q-values, positive/negative paths, contrast type, critiques, parser repairs, verifier output, rejection reasons, and random seeds.
  • Cost accounting is incomplete. The reported 10 versus 192 GPU-hours concerns recurring SFT, not the full one-time MCTS, proprietary analyst, synthesis, verification, retry, and data-cleaning budget. API tokens and monetary cost are undisclosed.
  • One headline ratio is inconsistent. 60K versus 590K is approximately a 9.8x size ratio, not 20x. The approximately 20x framing fits 30K versus 590K and the 10 versus 192 SFT GPU-hour comparison.
  • The release is not a locked replication package. The checked repository has no tagged release or LICENSE file, uses lower-bound rather than locked dependencies, and its paper-oriented config routes gpt-5-mini through an Anthropic backend. The dataset card labels CRPS-30K MIT, but upstream GSM8K/MATH and generated-derivative obligations still need audit.
  • Scope and contamination remain bounded. Objective terminal rewards make the method easiest for mathematics and code; open-ended domains remain difficult, as the authors state. Exact source snapshots and benchmark-overlap/decontamination procedures are unknown, while non-math experiments lack a matching public construction release.

• 终局验证不等于过程验证。 最终答案与参考答案精确匹配或 SymPy 等价时，中间推理仍可能无效、偶然或不忠实；验证器也不检查推理是否与批评一致。
  • 批评是模型判断。 GPT-5-mini 可能误判第一个分歧点，把局部算术错误解释成策略失败，或加入不必要限制。论文没有报告独立的批评忠实性验证器或人工错误标注。
  • 搜索分布假设可能失效。 方法把高访问次数视为顽固且有信息量的失败，但高访问错误分支也可能来自 UCT 噪声、价值估计错误、提示偏差或重复状态，而不是有教学价值的误解。这是根据反馈契约给出的策展推断。
  • 配对过程披露不完整。 论文同时称每题 10 次 rollout 和 10 个对比对，却没有公布逐题路径数、硬/软比例、配对缺口、复用、重试或阶段产出率。代码默认的 70%/30% 不能替代与论文实验完全匹配的清单。
  • 数量无法对齐。 名义 CRPS-30K 发布实际包含 27,256 行和 9,939 个唯一问题，而论文描述约 15K 个种子问题、每种子约两条合成变体。流失、重复和选择过程没有映射说明。
  • 发布时丢失谱系。 最终行只有 problem 与 solution，缺少来源 ID 与版本、树节点、访问次数与 Q 值、正负路径、对比类型、批评、解析修复、验证器输出、拒绝原因和随机种子。
  • 成本核算不完整。 报告的 10 对 192 GPU-hours 指重复执行的 SFT，而不是一次性 MCTS、专有分析模型、合成、验证、重试和数据清理的总预算。API token 与金额均未披露。
  • 一项标题级比例不一致。 60K 对 590K 的规模比约为 9.8 倍，不是 20 倍。接近 20 倍适用于 30K 对 590K，以及 SFT 的 10 对 192 GPU-hours。
  • 发布不是锁定的复现包。 核验仓库没有 tagged release 或 LICENSE 文件，依赖只声明版本下界而非锁定版本，面向论文的配置还把 gpt-5-mini 路由到 Anthropic backend。数据卡把 CRPS-30K 标为 MIT，但 GSM8K/MATH 上游条款和生成衍生数据义务仍需审计。
  • 范围与污染边界仍然存在。 正如作者所述，客观终局奖励使方法更适合数学与代码，开放式领域仍困难。确切来源快照和基准重叠/去污染流程未知，非数学实验也没有对应的公开构造发布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, CRPS is a concrete case study in converting a costly search trace into compact SFT data. It supports controlled comparisons among selection-only MCTS, local refinement, unguided teacher generation, random contrasts, and distribution-aware contrastive synthesis when methods share seed problems and the raw trajectory pool.

A reusable trace-level release would need more than the current two fields. At minimum, record an immutable seed/source ID and revision; explorer checkpoint and prompt version; every MCTS node, parent, semantic step, action, depth, visit count, Q estimate, UCT inputs, and terminal reward; positive-anchor choice and tie-break; hard/soft candidate pools; sampling probability and chosen pair IDs; global/local critique JSON; parser repairs; synthesis request, response, and retry count; extracted answer; exact/SymPy verifier version and decision; rejection reason; final sampling mode; RNG seeds; and checksums.

Those records would enable search-policy replay, contrast-selection studies, process-reward or critic training, critique-faithfulness evaluation, and audits of whether gains come from search diversity, proprietary analyst knowledge, or extra inference. Terminal correctness, search confidence, analyst critique, semantic-divergence label, and final SFT acceptance should remain separate signals rather than being collapsed into one quality score.

For direct CRPS-30K SFT reuse, pin the Hugging Face revision, record the observed 27,256 rows and 9,939 unique problems, hash data files, inspect duplicate solutions and normalized prompts, sample-audit intermediate mathematics, and verify GSM8K/MATH versions, licenses, and overlap with evaluation sets. Do not relabel the artifact as exactly 30,000 records or infer process labels from final prose.

For recipe reproduction, pin the Git commit and model revisions, clarify the gpt-5-mini backend, publish a tested lockfile and software license, disclose the hard/soft mixture and retry policy, and report end-to-end cost including explorer GPU work and analyst/synthesis API use. The current release is suitable for SFT experiments and recipe comparison after these checks; it is not sufficient for reconstructing each contrastive decision, training directly on negative trajectories, or auditing critique fidelity.

对分配的 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes 方向而言，CRPS 是把高成本搜索轨迹转成紧凑 SFT 数据的具体案例。当各方法共享相同种子问题和原始轨迹池时，它可用于受控比较只选择成功路径的 MCTS、局部修订、无引导教师生成、随机对比和分布感知对比合成。

真正可复用的轨迹级发布应远多于当前两个字段。至少应记录不可变种子/来源 ID 与版本、explorer checkpoint 及提示版本、每个 MCTS 节点、父节点、语义步骤、动作、深度、访问次数、Q 估计、UCT 输入与终局奖励、正锚点及并列裁决、硬/软候选池、采样概率与选中 pair ID、全局/局部批评 JSON、解析修复、合成请求/响应与重试次数、抽取答案、精确/SymPy 验证器版本与判定、拒绝原因、最终采样方式、随机种子和校验和。

这些记录可支持搜索策略重放、对比选择研究、过程奖励模型或批评器训练、批评忠实性评测，并审计增益究竟来自搜索多样性、专有分析模型知识还是额外推理。终局正确性、搜索置信度、分析模型批评、语义分歧标签和最终 SFT 接收应保持为不同信号，不能折叠为单一质量分。

直接复用 CRPS-30K 做 SFT 时，应固定 Hugging Face revision，报告实际观察到的 27,256 行与 9,939 个唯一问题，对数据文件取哈希，检查重复解答与规范化后的 prompt，抽样审计中间数学步骤，并核验 GSM8K/MATH 版本、许可证及其与评测集的重叠。不得把该产物改称恰好 30,000 条记录，也不能从最终文本反推真实过程标签。

复现配方时，应固定 Git commit 和模型版本，澄清 gpt-5-mini backend，发布经过测试的 lockfile 与软件许可证，披露硬/软比例和重试策略，并报告包含 explorer GPU 工作及分析/合成 API 用量的端到端成本。当前发布在完成上述检查后可用于 SFT 实验与配方比较，但不足以重建每个对比决策、直接训练负轨迹，或审计批评忠实性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep three objects separate: the MCTS tree, the positive/negative pair plus critiques, and the released synthesized problem/solution row.
  • Hard negatives are incorrect high-visit paths; soft negatives are correct paths longer than the shortest-correct anchor. Neither type is present in public rows.
  • Local critiques address an analyst-identified semantic divergence step, but only the synthesized final answer receives exact/SymPy verification.
  • Nominal CRPS-30K reports 27,256 examples and 9,939 unique problems; the approximately 15K seed-to-release attrition and duplication trail is missing.
  • Read the 20x statement carefully: 30K versus 590K and 10 versus 192 GPU-hours are approximately 20x comparisons; 60K versus 590K is approximately 9.8x.
  • Code and final data are official, but trees, contrasts, critiques, rejection logs, end-to-end costs, a tagged code release, a repository LICENSE, and a paper-matching locked configuration remain unresolved.

• 必须区分三种对象：MCTS 搜索树、正负轨迹对及其批评、公开的合成 problem/solution 行。
  • 硬负例是高访问错误路径，软负例是比最短正确锚点更长的正确路径；公开行不包含任何一种负例。
  • 局部批评指向分析模型识别的语义分歧步骤，但只有合成后的最终答案接受精确/SymPy 验证。
  • 名义 CRPS-30K 报告 27,256 条样本和 9,939 个唯一问题；约 15K 种子到发布数据的流失与重复链缺失。
  • 阅读 20 倍主张时要核算：30K 对 590K 与 10 对 192 GPU-hours 接近 20 倍，60K 对 590K 约为 9.8 倍。
  • 官方代码与最终数据已经公开，但搜索树、对比、批评、拒绝日志、端到端成本、代码 tagged release、仓库 LICENSE 和与论文匹配的锁定配置仍未解决。

value.html: Approximately 15K distinct training problems drawn from the GSM8K and MATH training splits; the paper describes roughly 7.5K from each. The released CRPS-30K card instead reports 9,939 unique problems among 27,256 examples, so the exact seed-selection and attrition manifest is not released.

The released record has two strings, problem and solution. Solutions are step-structured mathematical reasoning paths ending with a boxed final answer; the dataset card reports 100% boxed-answer coverage.

Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct explores math reasoning trees with MCTS. GPT-5-mini analyzes a selected positive trajectory against hard or soft negative trajectories and synthesizes a fresh solution conditioned on global and local contrastive critiques.

UCT-based Monte Carlo tree search with c_puct=1.4, maximum depth 16 semantic reasoning steps, at most three actions per node, and ten rollouts per problem. The math explorer is Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct; Appendix experiments substitute Qwen2.5-Coder-7B for code and LLaMA3-8B for commonsense.

Math tree terminals receive binary reward from strict ground-truth answer matching, and synthesized answers are retained only after answer extraction plus exact or SymPy-equivalence verification. Code uses unit tests and commonsense uses exact-answer matching in appendix experiments.

A synthesized math path is retained when its extracted final answer matches the reference answer under exact or SymPy equivalence; this validates the terminal answer, not the faithfulness or correctness of every intermediate step or critique.
The primary explorer is Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct. SFT targets are DeepSeekMath-7B-Base, LLaMA3-8B, and Mistral-7B-v0.1.
GPT-5-mini is the proprietary analyst and synthesizer for global/local contrastive analysis and fresh path generation.

Run MCTS, select the shortest correct trajectory as the positive anchor (breaking ties by maximum node Q), sample high-visit incorrect hard negatives and longer correct soft negatives, analyze global strategy and the first local divergence, synthesize a new critique-informed solution, then verify its final answer.

The paper reports K=10 contrastive pairs per problem and ten MCTS rollouts per problem. Hard negatives are sampled proportional to trajectory visit mass, and verified synthesized paths are uniformly sampled into nominal 15K, 30K, and 60K training sets. Pair reuse, replacement, yields at each stage, and the precise hard/soft mixture are undisclosed.

Use binary terminal correctness to separate correct and incorrect paths; choose a shortest correct anchor; sample incorrect paths proportional to accumulated visit counts or use correct paths longer than the anchor as soft negatives; discard malformed analyst outputs and synthesized paths whose final answer fails exact or SymPy verification.

Released configuration sets MCTS expansion temperature 0.7 with 256-token actions, simulations up to 2,048 tokens, ten rollouts, analyst temperature 0.7 with 1,024 tokens, and synthesis temperature 0 with 2,048 tokens. The paper does not provide complete API-token or monetary cost accounting.

Standard full-parameter SFT with AdamW (beta1=0.9, beta2=0.95), peak learning rate 2e-5, 3% warmup, cosine decay to zero, global batch size 128, and three epochs on eight A800 80GB GPUs using ZeRO-3 offload.

GSM8K train and MATH train supply the primary math seeds. Code and commonsense appendix studies change the explorer and verifier, but their seed snapshots, counts, and full construction budgets are not disclosed.

Training data are generated from GSM8K/MATH training seeds and evaluated on GSM8K, MATH, and out-of-domain math benchmarks. The paper reports nominal CRPS-15K/30K/60K pools; the public CRPS-30K artifact contains 27,256 train rows over 9,939 unique problems and no validation/test split.
unknown

items: Binary terminal rewards are practical only in verifiable domains and do not establish the validity of intermediate reasoning.
A final-answer match can retain spurious, unfaithful, or critique-inconsistent reasoning paths.
The analyst can hallucinate divergence explanations or improvement rationales, and no independent critique-faithfulness verifier is reported.
The method depends on proprietary GPT-5-mini behavior and incurs substantial upfront inference cost omitted from the reported SFT GPU-hour comparison.

The abstract states that 60K versus 590K is a 20x reduction, but 590K/60K is about 9.8x; the approximately 20x comparison is supported by CRPS-30K versus 590K and by the reported 10 versus 192 SFT GPU-hours.
The public artifact named CRPS-30K has 27,256 examples, not 30,000, and reports only 9,939 unique problems versus the approximately 15K seed problems described in the paper.
The release contains only final problem/solution pairs, not MCTS trees, negative trajectories, critiques, verification logs, rejection counts, or record-level provenance.
The paper reports K=10 contrastive pairs from ten rollouts per problem but does not disclose pair reuse, replacement, or the yield and mixture of hard versus soft negatives.

The repository configuration routes a model named gpt-5-mini through an Anthropic backend and environment variables; this released configuration requires clarification before it can be treated as executable replication evidence.
The GitHub README claims an MIT LICENSE file that is absent from the checked repository tree.
No explicit benchmark decontamination or immutable source/release revisions are reported.

value.html: The ACL paper is CC BY 4.0. The Hugging Face dataset card labels CRPS-30K as MIT. The GitHub README says the code project is MIT, but the official repository tree checked on 2026-07-22 contains no LICENSE file; upstream GSM8K and MATH terms and the rights status of generated derivatives require separate review.

GSM8K/MATH seed problem -> Qwen2.5-Math MCTS tree -> shortest correct anchor plus visit-weighted incorrect or longer-correct contrast -> GPT-5-mini global/local critique -> GPT-5-mini synthesized path -> exact/SymPy final-answer filter -> uniform sampling -> two-field problem/solution SFT release. The public dataset omits tree nodes, selected contrasts, critiques, verifier records, rejects, and per-record seed identifiers, so final records cannot be audited end to end.

The recipe and final data are available, but exact counts, licensing, configuration fidelity, cost accounting, and intermediate lineage remain incomplete.
